review:
Sugar Rush with Super Scatters. Winning symbols explode and mark their spot, and another explosion there in the same tumble sequence adds a 2x multiplier that doubles each time, up to 1,024x, with several adding together in one win.

Three or more scatters (or a mix with Super Scatters) trigger up to 30 free spins where the marks stay in place. When at least one Super Scatter helps trigger it, wins can reach 50,000x. 96.58% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
